trigger: The verified current checkout does not contain Validate-Technician-ExactHead.cmd or predates the exact-head field harness.
preconditions: A local AgentSwitchboard Git checkout exists.
The checkout origin is one of the canonical AgentSwitchboard origins.
The remote ref and exact expected SHA are known.
steps: Read the source checkout status and recent log without changing it.
Fetch the explicit remote ref without tags or force.
Require FETCH_HEAD to equal the expected SHA.
Extract the exact-head validator from the verified commit into a temporary UTF-8 file.
Invoke the extracted exact-head validator while passing the preserved source checkout.
Require a fresh exact-head JSON artifact whose verifiedHead equals the expected SHA.
Write local bootstrap JSON and Markdown reports.
Remove only the temporary extracted validator after execution.
failureHandling: Unexpected origin blocks before remote code extraction or execution.
Head mismatch blocks before worktree creation.
The source checkout remains read-only regardless of dirty state.
A nonzero delegated validator exit is propagated.
Missing or stale delegated artifacts block success.
forbidden: success from fetch or launcher acknowledgement alone
